feeds.title: Mandala of the Day
feeds.description: The author through this blog showcases mandalas one day at a time. This blog is about building a community of Mandala enthusiasts, those who love to create them and also for those who love to see them in a variety of different ways.

feeds.title: Mandala of the Month
feeds.description: Mandala of the Month is a place on the web through which it enlightens, inspires, and empowers people. The author Maureen Frank gives people of all ages an opportunity to tap into their creative side by coloring a mandala a month.

feeds.title: Phelps Mandalas Blog
feeds.description: I have been a medical illustrator for over 38 years. For the past 8 years creating nature mandalas is a personal quest. It further defines the joy I have had for the entirety of my life fascinated with and interpreting nature in pen and ink prints, animal doodles and cartoons and now full color representational nature mandalas. Read more about the art of Mandala in my blog.

feeds.title: Mandala of the Week
feeds.description: Mandala of the week has articles which help people to wake up to their own inner light in delightful, inspiring ways. The author Maureen Frank's mission is to explore, promote and inspire creativity among the people.

feeds.title: Mandala of the Year
feeds.description: The Mandala of the year blog brings awakening in people's Creative Spirit in delightful, inspiring ways. The author will post a section of a mandala for people to download and color and at the end of the year you'll be able to put all the sections together to create one complete Mandala.

feeds.title: Shristy Singh Blog
feeds.description: Hello everyone!! My name is Shristy Singh and I am a painting lover who loves all art forms and also loves to make the best out of waste. I personally like Mandala too much!! Read about my art experiences, guides and tips for drawing and more.

feeds.title: Kelly Dietrich Blog
feeds.description: I'm Kelly - a mandala and fractal artist living in Richmond, Virginia. My artwork is inspired by nature, infused with color, and joyfully created to promote health, peace, and happiness. Find my latest mandala and fractal artwork, products, announcements, and upcoming events.

feeds.title: Louise Gale Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Louise. I am a mixed media artist, who is passionate about combining the healing energy of nature and color with the meditative process of mandala making. Here, you will find blog posts about my own creative journey, resources & tools to help you dream, be inspired and create!

feeds.title: Mandala Meadow Blog
feeds.description: Mandala Meadow is a blog that works to teach people about mandala art. It was started by Kathryn, a mandala art teacher, writer, and photographer. Art styles that she covers include Arabic geometry, Celtic knots, and of course mandalas.

feeds.title: Callistyle » Mandala Art
feeds.description: This section features articles on mandala art. Callistyle have genuinely professional and up to date trainers to help you with your journey of Handwriting Improvement and Calligraphy.

feeds.title: fortyonehundred Blog
feeds.description: Lizzie Snow is a visual artist, working under her artist name 'fortyonehundred'. Inspired by fractals in nature, Lizzie creates contemporary explorations of the mandala and free-flowing artworks.

feeds.title: The Dotting Center Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Rachel, a dot artist with a passion to share the art of dotting with other artists like me! Join me for tips, tricks and tutorials about dotting.
